positions.title: Vice President
positions.description: As the VP for ACM I created a project concept for our members which involves selecting entry level engineering students to complete a two-month long project which involves both hardware and software aspects. The projects include designated team mentors and industry speakers to facilitate teaching the participants about real world concepts and team development skills. Topics include SCRUM, Agile vs Waterfall design, requirements engineering, project management, and team building skills. As the director I created the entire design of the projects and selected committee members to help implement the idea.

positions.title: Service Delivery Analyst
positions.description:
Worked on the service delivery team in the IT department of the Dallas Fed as a summer intern. 
•	Created a comprehensive SharePoint website for the Technology Debt initiative at the Bank
•	Met weekly with customers to create and manage requirements for the project
•	Facilitated daily team Stand-Ups
•	Maintained documentation for the project and created several high level procedural documents to be used across different Bank divisions
•	Shadowed Bank Project Managers and utilized Agile Design principles

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

projects.title: Computer Architecture Project
projects.description: I served as the Project Manager and worked with a team of four engineers to create a MIPS assembly language disassembler which takes instructions and directives from a text file and converts them into binary. The binary is then written to another text file and plays a sound if the process is done without any errors. As the project manager I created a list of requirements for the project before we began and set a timeline of when certain things were to be done by. I helped write the assembly code with my team and made sure things were done on schedule.

projects.title: Microsoft Mentorship Project
projects.description: I was selected to participate in the Microsoft mentorship program and lead a team of two to create a web based application called My Pantry which serves as a tool to store the contents of one’s pantry and fridge to assist in grocery shopping. The program included rigorous training in software design principles as well as project management methodologies including SCRUM, Agile design, and waterfall design. I organized the projects requirements and worked with my partner to create the web application using HTML and GitHub.
